name: Kamishiro Rise
source:
Hobbies: Bathing, yoga
Skills: Aikido
Favorite Food: Strawberry, sakura mochi, cherries
Weakness: Parsley, garlic, celery, coriander

The [url=/c46358]protagonist's[/url] look-alike twin sister. Despite being a kind and docile girl, she also has a stubborn side to her; whenever she's putting her mind onto something, she won't give up so easily. She also knows some aikido, due to her father's training when she was younger. Her skin is also weak against sunshine. Rise has a big love for the cherry blossoms, and she becomes energetic whenever she is nearby them.
